authority_note: Chat memory is not authority. This file and M4_HANDOFF.md are the disk-backed authority for continuing this work on the M4.

package.name: role-floor
package.digest_verification: fg-m4-bootstrap.sh verifies every entry before creating anything

provenance.commit_sha_note: Recorded in the external M4_ROLE_FLOOR_HANDOFF.json under ${HOME}/Desktop/FounderGate_M1_Role_Floor_Build/. A committed file cannot contain the digest of the commit that introduces it.

github_status.bundle_sha256_note: Recorded in the external handoff JSON, which is produced after the commit and the bundle.

m4_authority_boundaries: Builder cannot check or approve its own work
Checker cannot repair findings and cannot write advisor state
Advisor cannot write code and cannot write verifier state
Serial integration starts only from exact-SHA accepted inputs
Only one shared-surface integration writer may hold a lease at a time
Final verifier evaluates the exact final tree and SHA; a moved SHA is refused
Merge sheriff requires an exact final PASS and a mechanically valid founder decision receipt
No role can impersonate another role's state writer
Founder signature, production activation, deployment and destructive actions are hard stops on M4
M4 Terminal-0 remains the human operating position

founder_receipt.location: outside the package and outside the run root
founder_receipt.effect: until the founder creates a key and signs a receipt, the merge gate refuses by construction

unified_commands.compatibility_wrappers: not shipped; omitted to stay within the authorized file cap. The host-neutral commands are the interface.

independent_audit.must_be_run_by: a context that did not build this package

live_tmux_verification.reason: tmux is not installed on the build machine; all tmux behaviour is proven against a recording stub only

serial_integration.scope: registering this package in FounderGate manifests or launchers is a shared-surface write reserved for the M4 serial-integration role

founder_gate.note: activation is a founder decision, taken with a decision receipt, never by the floor

exact_next_action_after_clean_audit: git bundle verify <bundle> and compare its SHA-256 to the external evidence
git fetch the branch from the bundle into the M4 repository
run fg-m4-bootstrap.sh --host m4 --check --repo <M4_REPO_PATH> and require STATUS: M4_BOOTSTRAP_VERIFIED
run the selftest on the M4 with tmux present; require zero failures and no skipped live-tmux cases
open a serial-integration lane for manifest and launcher registration
take the founder gate before any activation
limitations: no live tmux verification on the build machine
no role has ever been launched through this package
the M4 repository path and origin basename are defaults and must be confirmed on the M4
the founder receipt key does not exist yet, so the merge gate refuses by construction
